description: Curated real-world URL literals over clickbench-url-1m, op=contains. A selectivity ladder spanning five orders of magnitude (0.61 down to 3e-6) with needle lengths 3-8, chosen to make prefilter prune/false-positive behaviour readable where the gen1 random substrings cannot. Selectivities measured on the column before authoring; bless stamps the authoritative truth. Extended with a second eight-rung ladder of curated URL literals (0.482 down to 4.0e-5): the https scheme, page-kind and search-path filters, a Yandex query param, and three referring hosts.

provenance.curated_by: hand-picked literals; selectivity measured on datasets/clickbench-url-1m/data.arrow
